headline: High: Langflow’s unsandboxed server-side execution and broad egress create dangerous default interaction risks; Whisper adds no direct mitigation and can amplify downstream misuse.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Langflow can ingest uploaded files and chain multiple agents, while Whisper processes audio files and can output transcribed text that may be fed into Langflow flows. That creates a plausible prompt-injection bridge through content the orchestrator may treat as trusted. The pairwise pathway is inferred from documented surfaces, not directly observed.
conditions: IF Whisper transcripts are imported into Langflow prompts or tool inputs without sanitization
IF Langflow flow nodes treat uploaded content as instructions
mitigations: Add a fixed system prompt that ignores instructions inside transcripts
Insert a transcript sanitizer before Langflow ingestion
Label Whisper output as untrusted data in the workflow
Review one sample flow for prompt-injection handling
requires-engineering: add provenance tags across the pipeline

B_data_leakage.rationale: Langflow touches flow inputs, intermediate outputs, uploaded files, and stores per-flow credentials; it also has broad network egress. Whisper touches audio/speech and can process audio files locally, but the pair can still move sensitive audio-derived text into Langflow’s server-side state and outbound API calls. The leakage path is plausible in default deployments, though not directly evidenced.
conditions: IF audio transcripts contain sensitive personal or business data
IF Langflow flows send transcript text to external model providers or HTTP services
mitigations: Restrict Langflow flows to local-only providers
Remove secrets from any flow that handles transcripts
Redact audio transcripts before ingestion
Check one flow for outbound HTTP destinations
requires-engineering: segregate sensitive audio workflows into a separate tenant

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Langflow has server-side filesystem write and subprocess execution, but Whisper has no write, network, or subprocess capabilities. There is no overlapping mutable resource in the profiles, so direct capability conflict is limited. Uncertainty is low because Whisper is effectively read-only from the pairwise perspective.
conditions: IF Whisper is wrapped in an external service that also writes to Langflow’s workspace
mitigations: Keep Whisper as a read-only component
Avoid sharing a writable directory between the two
Run Langflow flows sequentially for shared artifacts
Check for accidental file overwrite paths

D_cascading_error.rationale: Langflow can chain multiple agents and arbitrary HTTP services, so it may treat Whisper transcripts as authoritative input. Whisper itself only transcribes audio and does not verify downstream facts, making a classic cascade possible when Langflow acts on the transcript without validation. The interaction is inferred from documented behavior rather than reproduced evidence.
conditions: IF Langflow uses Whisper output as a source of facts for another agent or API call
IF no verification step checks transcript accuracy before action
mitigations: Add a human review step before actions
Require citations or source audio timestamps
Compare transcript against a second pass for critical flows
Mark Whisper output as draft-only
requires-engineering: add confidence gating before downstream actions

E_compliance.rationale: Langflow stores per-flow credentials and handles uploaded files on a server filesystem, while Whisper processes audio/speech and audio files. A compliance issue can arise if regulated audio or transcripts are stored in Langflow’s server-side state or sent to external providers, but the profiles do not show a specific residency or certification mismatch. Only Langflow is cited because the compliance concern is primarily about its storage and egress behavior.
conditions: IF regulated audio or transcripts are stored in Langflow beyond the approved retention window
IF Langflow routes regulated content to non-approved external services
mitigations: Set a short retention policy for transcript artifacts
Disable external providers for regulated flows
Document the data class handled by each flow
Delete test transcripts after review
